what: Names our own data flags as UNUSUAL and therefore worth a human look. Not a buy list, not advice, and not a prediction — the evidence score behind several of these rules was tested against forward returns and FAILED (negative #12). Every name carries the rule that surfaced it.

rules.conflict: evidence dimensions >=8 points apart (top ~11% of the universe)
rules.insider: cluster of separate insiders buying on the open market
rules.crowded: top-5% days-to-cover — a risk shape, NOT a direction (our short-interest study failed)
rules.discount: our own DCF fair value >40% above price — a question, not an answer
rules.young: high conviction but <8 years of history, so structurally invisible to the sleeve
rules.narrative: |news attention z| >= 1.5 vs the name's own baseline
